hints: Argentina's cadastre is provincial (Ley 26.209). Salta's open ArcGIS FeatureServer parcels are verified; CABA's WFS (catalogo_og_130:parcelas) is verified. Look for each province's Dirección de Catastro geoportal or IDE (IDERA lists provincial nodes: e.g. IDE Santa Fe, IDECOR Córdoba, Mendoza ATM/IDE, Buenos Aires ARBA 'Carto ARBA' / IDE PBA, Neuquén, Río Negro, Chubut, Entre Ríos ATER, Tucumán). Try WFS/ArcGIS bounded queries in the capital city of each province.
